data.one_liner: On‑device Flutter library for speech recognition, synthesis, speaker and audio tagging functions.
data.what_it_does: Provides offline APIs for speech‑to‑text, text‑to‑speech, speaker identification, audio tagging, VAD and other audio AI tasks. It runs on multiple platforms via native ONNX runtimes.
use_when: You need speech or audio AI features without internet connectivity
Your app targets Android, iOS, web, desktop and wants a single Flutter package
You want support for many audio functions (ASR, TTS, speaker ID, VAD, etc.)
avoid_when: You require cloud‑based large language models or streaming from a server
App size must be minimal and native binaries are a concern
You need only simple audio playback without AI processing
strengths: Broad set of audio AI capabilities
Cross‑platform support including web and desktop
weaknesses: Large native binaries increase app size
Setup involves platform‑specific native libraries and permissions
Documentation for Flutter integration is limited
data.setup_notes: Add the sherpa_onnx package and platform‑specific sherpa_onnx_* dependencies, configure ffi, grant microphone permissions, and ensure the correct native binaries are bundled for each target platform.
